hero.description:
I leverage over five years of Quality Assurance (QA) experience with global tech giants like AWS, Netflix, and Apple, combining this expertise with Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
I now architect secure, fault-tolerant, and production-ready backend systems within the .NET ecosystem, most recently shipping EKOMART, a live N-Tier e-commerce platform, as the capstone of an intensive backend engineering program.

about.title: Engineering Perspective
about.p1: My experience in localization and quality assurance for flagship products of prestigious brands has consistently reinforced a critical lesson: A single bug or process vulnerability can impact millions of users and severely damage brand reputation.
about.p2: Today, I apply that same meticulous precision and discipline to writing clean, maintainable, and secure code. I do not merely write syntax; I engineer robust systems that prioritize scalability and reliability.
about.p3: I recently completed a 320-hour, full-time backend engineering program run with the Istanbul Chamber of Commerce, building 11 progressively complex ASP.NET Core applications. Alongside Harvard's CS50 and an ongoing B.A. in Management Information Systems at Istanbul University, this consolidates my computer science foundations and lets me architect enterprise-grade solutions using C# and .NET Core.
about.p4: My Goal: To integrate my multidimensional perspective on quality, security, and architecture into a forward-thinking engineering team.
about.focus_backend: Backend & Architecture: Designing scalable systems using N-Tier architecture, the Repository/Unit of Work pattern, and SOLID principles, with a dual EF Core/Dapper data layer across C# and .NET Core.
about.focus_security: Data & Security: Ensuring data integrity with MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and Entity Framework Core; implementing ASP.NET Identity, JWT, and Google OAuth while proactively mitigating CSRF/XSS vulnerabilities through OWASP Secure Coding principles.
about.focus_quality: Process & Quality: As a Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certified developer, I execute process-driven development aimed at reducing technical debt and achieving operational excellence.

projects.title: Projects
projects.p1_desc: A full N-Tier e-commerce platform (Entities → Data → Business → Api/Web) with a dual EF Core/Dapper data layer behind a shared Repository/Unit of Work abstraction. Features ASP.NET Identity, Google OAuth, and JWT across separate MVC and API surfaces, atomic transaction-safe checkout with real-time stock re-validation, PDF/Excel/QR generation, and an AI-powered review moderation pipeline. Deployed to production on Azure App Service with a Cloudflare-proxied custom domain and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
projects.p2_desc: An enterprise-grade Content Management System developed in an N-Tier architecture using C# and .NET Core, featuring Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and secure file management. It is protected against CSRF, XSS, and other vulnerabilities through strict defensive programming practices.
projects.p3_desc: A decoupled API/MVC venue-booking system built with Dapper and T-SQL stored procedures for high-performance data access. Applies the Repository pattern and DTOs end-to-end, with sliding-window rate limiting to protect the API from abuse.

contact.title: What's Next?
contact.text: I am currently open to Backend, .NET Developer, and C# Developer positions, with a particular interest in the Fintech and E-commerce sectors. I am ready to contribute my multidimensional perspective on quality, security, and architecture to your team.
